Explain the example for put a card together

blocks.text: A small card combines several single-job classes. Each class still has one job: space, border, text size or layout.

These examples use Tailwind CSS 4 in a separate project. Install tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/cli. Put @import "tailwindcss"; in input.css and build with npx @tailwindcss/cli -i input.css -o output.css. Link output.css in HTML.

items: `font-bold` chooses a heavier text weight. Text size and heading meaning are separate choices.
`text-blue-800` chooses a dark blue text colour from the Tailwind theme palette.
`leading-7` gives each text line more vertical room, which can make a paragraph easier to read.

blocks.text: The card has a limited width, round border, inner space and an underlined link. The /books address must exist in your own site.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A good-looking link still needs a real destination. Replace /books with a route your project provides.
